title: AI lead research and personalized first lines
problem: Reps waste hours researching prospects before writing outreach.
steps: Export a target list from Apollo.io
Import into Clay and enrich with company/website data
Add an AI column prompting for a one-line personalized opener grounded in enrichment data
Review a sample manually, then push approved rows to your sequencer or sheet

title: Inbound lead qualification to CRM
problem: Form leads sit unscored and unrouted.
steps: Trigger a Zap on new Typeform submission
Send answers to a ChatGPT step with your ICP criteria; return score + reason
Create/update the HubSpot contact with score
Notify the owner in Slack for high scores

title: Meeting notes to CRM follow-up
problem: Call notes and next steps never make it into the CRM.
steps: Connect Fireflies.ai to your calendar to record calls
On transcript ready, trigger a Zap
Summarize next steps with an AI step and log to the HubSpot deal
Draft (not send) a follow-up email in Gmail for review

title: Auto-booking replies for interested prospects
problem: Back-and-forth scheduling slows deals.
steps: Watch a Gmail label for replies
Classify intent (interested / not now / unsubscribe) with the OpenAI API
For 'interested', draft a reply with your Calendly link
Keep a human approval step before sending

title: Support ticket triage and tagging
problem: Agents manually tag and route every ticket.
steps: Trigger on new Zendesk ticket
Classify category, urgency and language with an AI step
Write tags/priority back to the ticket
Route urgent tickets to an on-call group

title: Help-center answer bot
problem: The same questions get asked repeatedly.
steps: Consolidate FAQs and policies in your help center (or export from Notion)
Enable Intercom's AI agent on your help-center content
Set handoff rules to a human for billing/edge cases
Review unanswered questions weekly and add articles

title: Draft replies for the support inbox
problem: Small teams spend hours writing similar replies.
steps: Self-host or use n8n cloud; add a Gmail trigger
Retrieve relevant docs snippets and pass with the email to the Anthropic API
Save the result as a Gmail draft, never auto-send
Track edit rate to improve the prompt

title: Weekly support insights digest
problem: Nobody sees trends across hundreds of tickets.
steps: Schedule a weekly Make scenario to pull solved tickets
Batch-summarize top themes and emerging issues
Post the digest to a Slack channel
Link examples back to tickets

title: AI pair programming in the editor
problem: Boilerplate and unfamiliar codebases slow developers.
steps: Install Cursor and open your repo
Add project rules describing conventions
Use chat/agent mode for scoped changes, review diffs
Commit via normal PR flow on GitHub

title: Terminal coding agent for refactors
problem: Multi-file refactors are tedious and error-prone.
steps: Install Claude Code and run it in your repo
Describe the refactor and ask for a plan first
Let it edit and run tests; review each change
Open a PR for human review

title: AI pull request review
problem: PRs wait days for a first review pass.
steps: Enable Copilot code review on the repository
Request Copilot as a reviewer on PRs
Treat comments as suggestions; humans approve merges
Tune with repository custom instructions

title: Error-to-issue triage
problem: Production errors pile up without context.
steps: Configure Sentry alerts for new issues
Trigger a Zap that summarizes the stack trace with an AI step
Create a Linear issue with summary and Sentry link
Assign by code owner

title: Scheduled dependency and test agent
problem: Dependency drift breaks builds unexpectedly.
steps: Create a scheduled GitHub Actions workflow
Run tests after dependency updates
On failure, invoke a coding agent in CI to propose a fix branch
Require human review before merging

title: Blog post to social thread repurposing
problem: Long-form content rarely gets repurposed.
steps: Paste the post into ChatGPT with platform-specific instructions
Generate threads/posts and edit for voice
Create visuals in Canva
Schedule in Buffer

title: SEO content brief generator
problem: Writers start without clear search intent.
steps: Export queries with high impressions/low CTR from Search Console
Research each topic with Perplexity, keeping sources
Generate a brief (intent, outline, questions) in Notion
Assign to a writer

title: Newsletter drafting from curated links
problem: Weekly newsletters take hours to assemble.
steps: Curate articles in Feedly or Readwise
Export highlights weekly
Ask Claude to draft summaries in your voice
Edit and send via Mailchimp

title: Competitor change monitor
problem: Competitor pricing and launches go unnoticed.
steps: Schedule n8n to fetch competitor pricing/changelog pages
Diff against last snapshot
Summarize meaningful changes with the OpenAI API
Post to Slack

title: Transaction categorization and monthly review
problem: Spreadsheets of transactions never get reviewed.
steps: Connect accounts with Tiller to feed Google Sheets
Use Tiller AutoCat rules for categorization
Monthly, paste a category summary (no account numbers) into ChatGPT
Ask for anomalies and a short spending review

title: Budget coach with zero-based budgeting
problem: Budgets fall apart mid-month.
steps: Set up categories and targets in YNAB
Export a monthly report
Ask Claude to review overspending and suggest reallocations
Apply changes manually in YNAB

title: Receipt and invoice capture for freelancers
problem: Receipts get lost before tax time.
steps: Filter receipt emails into a Gmail label
Zap extracts vendor, date, amount with an AI step
Save attachments to Google Drive
Append a row to a Sheets expense log

title: Small-business bookkeeping assistant
problem: Uncategorized transactions pile up.
steps: Connect bank and Stripe to QuickBooks
Use QuickBooks' AI-assisted categorization
Review suggestions weekly
Hand clean books to your accountant

title: Training plan from your activity data
problem: Generic plans ignore your actual training history.
steps: Export recent Strava activities
Summarize weekly volume in Sheets
Ask ChatGPT for a progressive plan with constraints (time, injuries)
Re-review every 2 weeks; consult a professional for medical concerns

title: Meal-prep planner and grocery list
problem: Planning meals for macros is time-consuming.
steps: Give ChatGPT targets, preferences and budget
Ask for a 7-day plan and consolidated grocery list
Save to a Notion template
Adjust weekly based on what you actually ate

title: Workout log with weekly AI check-ins
problem: Logs exist but nobody analyzes progress.
steps: Log sets/reps in Google Sheets
Weekly Make scenario reads the sheet
OpenAI API summarizes progress and plateaus
Email yourself the check-in

title: Local voice assistant for smart home
problem: Cloud assistants send everything off-device.
steps: Install Home Assistant
Run a local model with Ollama
Use Whisper-based speech-to-text via Home Assistant's voice pipeline
Expose only chosen entities to the assistant

title: Camera object detection alerts
problem: Motion alerts are noisy and useless.
steps: Install Frigate with your cameras
Configure object detection zones (person, car)
Integrate with Home Assistant
Send notifications only for relevant objects

title: Household maintenance agent
problem: Filter changes, warranties and chores get forgotten.
steps: List appliances, manuals and dates in Notion
Ask Claude to propose a maintenance schedule
Create recurring Google Calendar events
Review seasonally

title: Literature review assistant
problem: Finding and summarizing papers takes weeks.
steps: Ask your research question in Elicit
Screen papers and extract key columns
Save sources to Zotero
Verify claims against the original papers

title: Cited web research briefs
problem: Quick research lacks sources.
steps: Ask Perplexity a focused question
Check the cited sources
Save the brief to Notion
Re-run monthly for updates

title: Personal knowledge base Q&A
problem: Notes become impossible to search.
steps: Keep notes in Obsidian
Install a community plugin that connects to a local Ollama model
Index your vault locally
Ask questions with links back to notes

title: Meeting transcription and action items
problem: Action items from meetings get lost.
steps: Connect Otter.ai to your calendar
Let it join and transcribe meetings
Share summary and action items to Slack
Assign owners manually

title: Ops request intake to Airtable
problem: Internal requests arrive in scattered DMs.
steps: Create a Slack workflow or channel for requests
Zap classifies request type and priority with AI
Create an Airtable record
Post status back in-thread
